notes: Colours are RGBA 0..1 exactly as passed to the renderer; the UI shader writes them straight to the screen (no gamma), so CSS rgb = value * 255. scale = window height / 720 (1.0 here); textScale = max(1, round(2 * scale)) = 2; hints are 0.75 of it, not rounded (1.5). All widget geometry below is from src/client/ui.cpp.
accentNote: Ui::accent = the player's TEAM COLOR setting (color_friendly, default 64,217,255). The enemy colour (color_enemy, default 255,77,64) only shows in the title logo's Q. Each page carries the colours it was captured with (page.accent, page.enemy).
panelLook: Ui::panel(x,y,w,h,alpha=0.75): rect [0.05,0.06,0.08,alpha], then a 2*scale px accent line along its top edge (inside the panel). Labels drawn after it are fitted to its width (Ui::box) until a narrower box is set.

button.hoverUnderline: accent, 2*scale px along the bottom edge (inside)

font.notes: Rubik Bold (variable font at wght 700, src/client/font_ui.h, tools/make_font_atlas.py); Settings > FONT can pick another built-in (each sized so its capitals are as tall as Rubik's) or a mods/fonts file. A text call takes the TOP-LEFT of a line box 8*textScale px tall (textHeight). em = 7.5 units: CSS font-size = 7.5*textScale px (15 px at textScale 2). Cap tops sit 0.75*textScale px below the top, cap height 5.25 units, so the baseline is 6.0*textScale px below y. Width = sum of advances (+ kerning/16) * textScale, minus what a fit closed up. Text below scale 1.3 is drawn at 1.3. Every glyph has a black outline max(1, 0.15*textScale) px outside its edge. Characters outside ASCII 32..126 draw as '?'. Mono text (console) uses a fixed 5.3-unit advance per character.

fit: Every label is fitted to a width (maxW: the caller's, else the current Ui::box, e.g. a panel's): first closed up (each pair of letters as far as its ink allows, never touching: 'track' is that level in font units), then smaller (down to 1.3), and only then cut with '...' ('shown' is what was drawn, 'label' the full text). Buttons, tabs, cycles, dropdowns and colour pickers fit their own text the same way to w - 8*scale; sliders shrink then cut the LABEL so the number always shows whole.

widgetLook.button: rect bg (or hover / disabled colour); label centred both ways at textScale (fitted to w - 8*scale); hover adds the accent underline (2*scale px at the bottom).
widgetLook.tab: Ui::tab: a tab of a tab row. Not current: a button. Current: filled with accent*0.6 (a page tab) or accent*0.35 alpha 0.95 plus a 2*scale accent line at the bottom (a sub-page tab, 'sub'), white label centred.
widgetLook.toggle: a button whose text is 'LABEL: ON' or 'LABEL: OFF' (element.shown); same colours as a button, no other ON/OFF marker.
widgetLook.cycle: three parts on one row of height h: a '<' button (h x h) at the left, a '>' button (h x h) at the right, and between them a rect [0.08,0.09,0.11,0.95] with the current option name centred (fitted to w - 2h - 8*scale). The element's label is only an id: it isn't drawn.
widgetLook.slider: track rect [0.08,0.09,0.11,0.95] over the whole widget; fill rect from the left, width w*(v-min)/(max-min), colour [accent*0.45, 0.95]; centred text 'LABEL: number' (number = printf(fmt, v)); a faint box behind the number: rect from (numberX-3*scale, y+3*scale) size (numberW+6*scale, h-6*scale), white alpha 0.05 (0.14 under the mouse, plus a 1*scale px white 0.7 underline). No knob. Hovering a slider away from its default shows a tag above it: dark rect [0,0,0,0.75] with 'RIGHT-CLICK: RESET' at the smallest scale.
widgetLook.text: text field: rect [0.08,0.09,0.11,0.95] ([0.1,0.12,0.16,1] when focused); a 2*scale px line along the bottom: [0.3,0.3,0.35,1] (accent when focused); value left-aligned at x+6*scale, vertically centred, textScale, white; a long value shows its END. The element label 'FIELD <n>' is an internal id; the caption is a separate label element.
widgetLook.colorpicker: Ui::colorPicker: a button (idle / hover colours, accent underline under the mouse or while open) with its label on the left (x+8*scale, fitted) and a swatch of the colour on the right: 36*scale wide, min(h-8*scale, 22*scale) tall, 8*scale from the right edge, a 1 px black frame. value: '#RRGGBB'; def: the right-click default. Clicking opens the picker popup under it.
widgetLook.dropdown: Ui::dropdown: a button-coloured field with 'LABEL: VALUE  V' centred ('  ^' while open), accent underline under the mouse or while open; clicking opens the list popup under it.
widgetLook.popup: Ui::popups(), drawn over the page while a picker / dropdown is open (modal: the other widgets are 'blocked'). popup 'dropdown': a rect [0.05,0.06,0.08,0.98] at (field x, field bottom + 4*scale), field width, 8*scale padding, one entry a row (rowH = the field's height, 4*scale apart): the picked one filled with the accent, the others button-coloured, names centred. popup 'color': the same dark box with a 2*scale accent top line, 12*scale padding: a 168x120 saturation (across, white to the hue) / value (down, to black) square, a 20 px hue bar (red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, red, top to bottom), and under them the hex field (96x28), a 28 px swatch and the R G B numbers as a hint.
widgetLook.key: a hotkey on that screen (no rect; x,y,w,h are 0). key = GLFW key code, hold = an action held down.
widgetLook.handle: an invisible draggable spot (editor gizmo arrow, HUD widget box): rect where it can be grabbed, dx/dy the drag direction.
widgetLook.view: a clickable 3D view area (editor: click to select; spectating: click to watch the next player). Nothing drawn by the UI.
widgetLook.custom: a hand-drawn button: its look is the rect/label elements drawn just before/after it; only its hit area is this element.
widgetLook.label: text at (x, y) = top-left of its line box, at textScale with its colour; align center: x is the left edge as drawn, cx the centre. maxW: the width it was fitted to; fitScale / track: how it was fitted; shown: the cut text. hint: Ui::hint (textScale 1.5, grey [0.7,0.72,0.75]). raw: a direct Renderer::text call (not via Ui), mono: console font. style 'logo': the QUARK title (Renderer::logo): Rubik 800 baked like the app icon (tools/make_logo.py), the Q split by a slanted line, its left and UARK in the friendly colour (color), its right in the enemy colour (enemy); em = 7.5*textScale*0.66/0.70, baseline 5.7*textScale below y; in another UI font: the word in that font, the Q split the same way.
widgetLook.rect: a plain filled rectangle (direct Renderer::rect); colour RGBA. gradient: [tl, tr, br, bl] corner colours (Renderer::rectGradient, the colour picker's ramps).

caret: white bar, width max(1, round(0.6*textScale)) px, height 1.05*8*textScale, starting scale px right of the text end and 0.05*textHeight above its top, 1 px black (alpha 0.8) border; blinks 0.5 s on / 0.5 s off.
menuChrome: Menu screens (not in game) draw a full-screen dark rect, then a veil over the 3D backdrop map in the real game (the UI test never loads it, so screenshots show a flat dark background); the QUARK title logo centred at textScale 8*scale (not on Settings); the version at the bottom-left. These are ordinary elements of each page.
pauseVeil: In game, the pause menu dims the 3D view with a full-screen rect (not under the HUD / widget / crosshair editors).
